h1: A security review of how your accounts are protected
overview: We look at how your product handles accounts and point out where it is weak. We review password storage, login and reset flows, session settings, permission checks, rate limiting, email verification and what your logs reveal. You receive a plain-language report that ranks each finding by risk, with the fix beside it. This is a focused review, not a full penetration test.

faq: No. It is a review of how accounts are built, using your code or screens and safe testing on a test version. It finds common gaps but cannot promise that everything is found.
Do I need to give you production access?
No. We prefer a test copy or read-only access to code. We do not test against live customer data, and we never ask for passwords. You can remove our access once we finish.
Will you tell anyone about what you find?
No. Findings go only to you. We treat the report as private, and we recommend keeping it that way. Any disclosure to your own customers is your decision.
Does this give me a security certificate?
No. We are not an auditing body and do not issue compliance certificates. You receive a practical report and fixes that help you pass your own customers' questions.
